item.title: Choose a Controller for Your Product Line
item.description:
The right controller is the one that matches your target platform, customer and retail positioning. These five models serve different briefs; use their product pages for the full configuration and confirm the selected version before listing or ordering.

Quick comparison for your shortlist

On a phone, swipe the table sideways to compare. Open a model for its full specification.

Quick comparison for your shortlist
ModelMain distinctionConfirm before ordering
G17Hall Effect sticks; four programmable back buttons; integrated audioRequired functions on each target platform
G1TMR sticks; micro-switch ABXY; dual-mode triggersConnection modes and final bundle
G2TMR sticks; battery display; switchable button layoutCharging dock is optional, not standard
G6 ProHall Effect sticks; Bluetooth, 2.4GHz and wired modesReceiver optional; no Switch 2 wake-up
G7Micro-switch ABXY; up to 1000Hz wired / 2.4GHz1000Hz does not apply to Bluetooth; confirm receiver bundle

Start with your customer’s use case

G17 — a PS5-compatible starting point

Choose G17 if your range needs a PS5-compatible controller. Its current product page lists Hall Effect joysticks, four programmable back buttons and integrated audio controls. An unbranded evaluation sample can be requested, subject to the current configuration and availability. Confirm the functions needed on each target platform before committing to retail copy.

item.title: Samples, Branding & Packaging: What to Confirm
item.description:
A useful first quotation starts with the exact model and the type of sample you need. Evaluation samples, unbranded samples and custom-branded production are different requests.

Ordering & Shipping FAQ

Small wholesale orders, custom branding and dropshipping are different services. Check the options below before requesting a quotation.

Can I start with 5 or 10 units?

Yes. Small wholesale orders of 5 or 10 units are welcome. These orders use the factory’s existing logo and factory-branded packaging, without custom branding. Confirm the model and current availability when requesting a quote.
